P01.rationale: The founder is mentioned as a bottleneck but not visually represented; no portrait anchor exists.

P05.rationale: The client 'Conesso GmbH' is clearly named and framed in the dark panel with meaningful size relative to the column.

P07.rationale: A testimonial-style quote block exists at the bottom of the right panel, though it lacks a formal grid or rating card structure.

P10.rationale: The '04' numeral and the large '30/2' typography act as oversized decorative ghost elements anchoring the layout.

P11.rationale: Real data visualizations are present in the form of specific before/after metrics (e.g., '30 to 2 minutes') and workflow counts.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks and graphical elements.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present via the dark blue panel overlaying the off-white paper grain.

P14.rationale: The text on the right panel sits directly on a solid color block rather than being overlaid on a treated photo, so this criterion does not apply in its intended form.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown to add credibility; only abstract typography and text blocks are used.

N07.rationale: The imagery appears generic/stock rather than specific to a real business context (no actual photos of the founder or office).

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content across both columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim; it sits cleanly within defined text blocks and panels.
